73.
 (1)  The Board may make rules in respect of  matters
for which rules are authorized or required to be made under
this Act or which it may consider necessary for the purpose
of achieving its objective.
(2) In particular and without prejudice to the generality
of the  powers conferred by subsection (1), the Board may
make rules in respect of the following matters:-

(a)
the  manner  and  mode  of  application  for
registration of security rights and of judgment
creditors; and

(b)
amount  of  fees  or  charges  to  be  levied  in
respect  of  services  that  are  provided  by  the
Authority.
(3)    All  rules  made  by  the  Board  under  subsection  (1)
shall be approved by the Minister and be published thereafter
in the Gazette.
